name: flagazo
description: Party game multijugador de banderas en tiempo real

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
